<?php

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private array $pendingCallbacks = [];
    private bool $shuttingDown = false;
    private int $drainTimeout = 5;
    
    public function addConnection(Connection $conn): void {
        $this->connections[$conn->getId()] = $conn;
    }
    
    public function removeConnection(int $id): void {
        unset($this->connections[$id]);
    }
    
    public function getConnection(int $id): ?Connection {
        return $this->connections[$id] ?? null;
    }
    
    public function registerDrainCallback(int $connId, callable $cb): void {
        $this->pendingCallbacks[$connId] = $cb;
    }
    
    public function isShuttingDown(): bool {
        return $this->shuttingDown;
    }
    
    public function initiateShutdown(): void {
        $this->shuttingDown = true;
    }
    
    public function getPendingCallbacks(): array {
        return $this->pendingCallbacks;
    }
    
    public function clearCallback(int $connId): void {
        unset($this->pendingCallbacks[$connId]);
    }
}

class Connection {
    private int $id;
    private string $buffer = '';
    private bool $closed = false;
    private ?resource $socket;
    
    public function __construct(int $id, $socket) {
        $this->id = $id;
        $this->socket = $socket;
    }
    
    public function getId(): int {
        return $this->id;
    }
    
    public function write(string $data): bool {
        if ($this->closed) return false;
        $this->buffer .= $data;
        return true;
    }
    
    public function flush(): bool {
        if ($this->closed || !is_resource($this->socket)) return false;
        $written = @fwrite($this->socket, $this->buffer);
        if ($written === false) return false;
        $this->buffer = substr($this->buffer, $written);
        return true;
    }
    
    public function close(): void {
        $this->closed = true;
        if (is_resource($this->socket)) {
            fclose($this->socket);
        }
        $this->socket = null;
    }
    
    public function isClosed(): bool {
        return $this->closed;
    }
}

class ProxyServer {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private array $upstreamMap = [];
    private bool $running = true;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->pool = new ConnectionPool();
    }
    
    public function handleNewConnection($clientSocket): Connection {
        static $nextId = 1;
        $conn = new Connection($nextId++, $clientSocket);
        $this->pool->addConnection($conn);
        return $conn;
    }
    
    public function mapUpstream(int $clientId, int $upstreamId): void {
        $this->upstreamMap[$clientId] = $upstreamId;
    }
    
    public function forwardData(int $fromId, string $data): bool {
        $targetId = $this->upstreamMap[$fromId] ?? null;
        if ($targetId === null) return false;
        
        $target = $this->pool->getConnection($targetId);
        if ($target === null) return false;
        
        return $target->write($data);
    }
    
    public function gracefulShutdown(): void {
        $this->pool->initiateShutdown();
        $this->drainConnections();
    }
    
    private function drainConnections(): void {
        $callbacks = $this->pool->getPendingCallbacks();
        
        foreach ($callbacks as $connId => $callback) {
            $conn = $this->pool->getConnection($connId);
            if ($conn === null) {
                $this->pool->clearCallback($connId);
                continue;
            }
            
            // Flush remaining data before closing
            $conn->flush();
            
            // Execute the drain callback - this may trigger upstream cleanup
            $callback($conn);
        }
        
        // Phase 2: close all connections that had callbacks
        foreach ($callbacks as $connId => $callback) {
            $conn = $this->pool->getConnection($connId);
            if ($conn !== null) {
                $conn->close();
                $this->pool->removeConnection($connId);
            }
            $this->pool->clearCallback($connId);
        }
    }
    
    public function registerGracefulHandler(int $clientId): void {
        $upstreamId = $this->upstreamMap[$clientId] ?? null;
        
        // The callback captures $this and the upstream ID for cleanup
        $this->pool->registerDrainCallback($clientId, function(Connection $clientConn) use ($upstreamId) {
            if ($upstreamId !== null) {
                $upstream = $this->pool->getConnection($upstreamId);
                if ($upstream !== null) {
                    $upstream->write("PROXY_DISCONNECT\n");
                    $upstream->flush();
                    // Close and remove upstream immediately during drain
                    $upstream->close();
                    $this->pool->removeConnection($upstreamId);
                }
            }
            $clientConn->write("CONNECTION_CLOSING\n");
        });
        
        // Also register callback for the upstream side
        if ($upstreamId !== null) {
            $this->pool->registerDrainCallback($upstreamId, function(Connection $upstreamConn) use ($clientId) {
                $client = $this->pool->getConnection($clientId);
                if ($client !== null) {
                    $client->write("UPSTREAM_GONE\n");
                    $client->flush();
                }
            });
        }
    }
    
    public function getPool(): ConnectionPool {
        return $this->pool;
    }
}

// Simulation of proxy lifecycle
function simulateProxy(): void {
    $server = new ProxyServer();
    
    $clientSocket = fopen('php://memory', 'r+');
    $upstreamSocket = fopen('php://memory', 'r+');
    
    $client = $server->handleNewConnection($clientSocket);
    $upstream = $server->handleNewConnection($upstreamSocket);
    
    $server->mapUpstream($client->getId(), $upstream->getId());
    $server->registerGracefulHandler($client->getId());
    
    // Simulate some data flow
    $server->forwardData($client->getId(), "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n");
    
    // Trigger graceful shutdown
    $server->gracefulShutdown();
}

simulateProxy();
